title: 30 New GTA 6 PS5 Screenshots Will Blow You Away
description: Rockstar has updated its official website with 30 new GTA 6 screenshots following last week's Extended Look, showcasing incredible visual details.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Stunning New GTA 6 Screenshots Hit Official Website

Following last week's mind-blowing Extended Look, Rockstar Games has treated fans to even more visual treats by adding a fresh batch of GTA 6 screenshots to its official website, according to a recent report by Push Square.

Gaming enthusiasts have discovered that around 30 new images have made their way to the official portal. Some of these striking visuals were previously shared exclusively among select influencers. As a result, eagle-eyed fans might have already spotted a few of them floating around across various social media platforms—such as the highly discussed, incredibly detailed iguana image that has been making the rounds online.

## Building Hype After the Extended Look

The timing of this screenshot drop couldn't be better. It comes hot on the heels of the recent extended promotional footage that left the gaming community in awe with its next-generation lighting, dense open-world activity, and remarkable attention to detail. By publishing these high-resolution images directly on their official website, Rockstar continues to feed the massive appetite for any and all information regarding the highly anticipated title.

While static images don't give away new gameplay mechanics, they serve as a powerful reminder of the graphical leap Rockstar is aiming for on current-gen hardware like the PlayStation 5.

## Editor's Take

Rockstar's drip-feed marketing strategy continues to work wonders. Dropping 30 new screenshots right after a major media showcase keeps the community deeply engaged and analyzing every single pixel. These stunning visuals only amplify the excitement for what is shaping up to be a monumental release.
